hero.name: Juan Sebastian
hero.tagline: I build web applications and platforms with React, JavaScript and Node.js, integrating AI, APIs and analytics into complete experiences.

about.title: About me
about.paragraph: I am a Software Developer with experience building web applications and platforms using React, JavaScript, Node.js, and WordPress. I have developed AI-powered real-time support solutions, integrating APIs, CRMs, and backend logic to deliver complete web experiences. I have also implemented analytics solutions with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Looker Studio to turn data into actionable business insights. I always enjoy learning new technologies and implementing solutions that add value.

highlights.title: Embeddable AI Chat Widget
highlights.description: I built the frontend of an AI-powered chat widget, embeddable on any website through a configurable script, allowing companies to integrate an intelligent support channel without any additional development on their part.

highlights.title: Worker Console — Real-Time Support Platform
highlights.description: I designed the frontend of a WhatsApp-style real-time messaging application, allowing agents and supervisors to manage conversations, support queues, transfers, SLAs and performance metrics.

highlights.title: Web Platform Rebuild for International Educational Fair
highlights.description: I led the rebuild of an international educational fair web platform, implementing the interface from Figma designs on WordPress, with dynamic templates, components and forms integrated with CRMs such as Bitrix 24.

highlights.title: Web Analytics Implementation and Reporting
highlights.description: I implemented an analytics ecosystem by configuring Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4, and built Looker Studio reports with visualizations and metrics to generate business insights.

highlights.title: Teaching and instructional materials
highlights.description: I taught classes and provided guidance on MySQL, Oracle, Laravel, JavaScript and Algorithms to groups of trainees, and helped create guides and instructional materials.
